summary: Derive native claim attribution from the connected writer and align native mutation scopes with client actions.

replay.detail: Existing retained claims and replay behavior are unchanged.

rules.detail: Existing dedicated claim-kind policies remain in force.

compatibility.detail: Connected agent, native and paired writers use their derived actor and matching sender attribution. Paired native mutations require the corresponding control scope; legacy ask completion and custom replies use control.attention. Ordinary local actor omission remains nullable.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal binary rollout.

manual.detail: No data migration is required. Clients continue using their existing concrete writer identity and applicable action scopes.

recovery.detail: Normal binary rollback requires no retained-data conversion.
